description: Submission of the Motor Traffic (Examination) Regulations No.03 of 2026
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Investigations conducted by Motor Vehicle Examiners into many of the recent highprofile serious road accidents in the country have revealed that the accidents were caused by mechanical defects in the running condition of the vehicles. Therefore, the National Transport Commission, the Provincial Road Passenger Transport Authorities or the Sri Lanka Transport Board have identified the need to establish a system for testing the roadworthiness of vehicles engaged in passenger transport service, school transport service, office transport service and vehicles engaged in special tours carried out on a hiring basis. The Motor Traffic (Examination) Regulations No.03 of 2026 have been published through the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2489/22 dated 2026-05-19, introducing legal provisions for this purpose, in accordance with the provisions of the Motor Traffic Act (Chapter 203).  The proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
